newsitem.title: USA: GPU wants NJ energy plan clarification.
newsitem.headline: GPU wants NJ energy plan clarification.

text.p: GPU Inc blieves New Jersey's energy master plan needs clarification, GPU Energy vice president of corporate affairs for New Jersey, Elizabeth Ard, told regulators Tuesday.
Voicing suport for the Board of Public Utilities' power industry restructuring recommendations, she told the board GPU's distribution subsidiary has some concerns.
"We believe this plan needs clarification in order to adequately address the issue of stranded costs, especially pertaining to non-utility generation contracts," said Ard.
"We also have questions regarding the appropriate application of securitization as a method for recovery of stranded costs."
